title: Input stability and grid marks in the labels
label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Voice labels model-coded, not checked by a person; transcripts are recognizer output; agreement of two machines, not accuracy.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
written_by: a step-1 agent (a model agent working for the project lead; not a person)

bases.all_seen_labelled: 1,284 voice-label files of the 71 seen creators (13 with no words after the filter); primary I base 65 creators; middle model 50 to 59
bases.BR-GS: 40 shifted-grid re-decodes, one per creator; R2 base between 10 and 19 creators
bases.bridge: 35 seen bridge decodes, one per creator
bases.by_voice: recordings holding both voices: between 5 and 9 creators (grid), 11 (bridge)

I_seam_lock_of_claimed_voice_boundaries.reading: undetermined; some rows' readings are not printed for privacy
I_seam_lock_of_claimed_voice_boundaries.R1_circular_shift: -0.047 (90% -0.057 to -0.037; HKSJ floored, r3-P30 class B row 50); t on creator means -0.033 (-0.043 to -0.022); estimators disagree
I_seam_lock_of_claimed_voice_boundaries.named_rows: entries -0.071 (-0.084 to -0.057), against the named positive direction; middle and exits: not printed (the rows' counts are banded)
I_seam_lock_of_claimed_voice_boundaries.R2_redecode: not printed: the row's count is banded

II_punctuation_agreement_near_seams.IIa_grid_shift: +0.325 (0.285 to 0.365; t, B1 row 40): beyond the margin as a row
II_punctuation_agreement_near_seams.IIb_model_change: -0.024 (-0.090 to 0.043): named row points the other way

voice_difference.grid: not printed: the row's count is banded

seam_zone_rule: recommended: an exclusion row for the seam zone (within 1 s of a run-grid seam) in r3-P01, r3-P06, r3-P07 and r3-P09
half_effect_disclosure: 56 primaries; about 2.8 floor-rule passes expected by chance at half the margin
contacts: none: one logged read of the bridge plan, ruled not a contact (D31; the lead's step-1 decision 6); contacts.md
not_stored: labels on any second decode (shifted grid or bridge)
shifted-grid decodes beyond BR-GS's 40 recordings; bridge decodes beyond rv-R3's 35 seen recordings
departures: measures and references operationalised by the agent in code/prespec.json (R2 as projection onto the re-decode's units; placebo-seam zone for II)
within-creator bootstrap variance for R1's random-effects method
seam-distance flag as a function, not a stored per-token file
not run: relabelling (class c), whole-roster grid shift (a.2), r3-P19's input-perturbation share, labels on bridge transcripts
removed thanks phrases identified by replaying the filter's thanks rule (phase peak partly by construction)
for_the_lead: primary II's named row IIb shares the grid with the record, so it was bound to point away from IIa; II reads undetermined under the pre-specified rule
primary I lies beyond the margin against the named direction for entries and exits; the deposited readings have no word for that
seam-zone exclusion recommended for r3-P01, r3-P06, r3-P07, r3-P09
D5 coupling weaker in claimed voice by 5.6 points (2.3 to 8.8; described, not read)
